name: A Little to the Left
short_description: Tidy, sort and straighten household things into satisfying order, while a cat keeps messing it up.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Tidy, sort and straighten household things into satisfying order, while a cat keeps messing it up.

identity.core_loop: Look at a messy little scene, drag things until they line up or sort, the puzzle snaps tidy; a cat sometimes undoes it.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Fussy in the nicest way; the snap when things line up is the reward.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: The scene is the whole interface: the finished state shows itself by clicking into place. Hints are summoned, and some puzzles accept more than one tidy answer.

identity.art_direction: Soft hand-drawn objects on paper-like backgrounds.

rendering.signature: Soft hand-drawn objects with gentle ink edges on warm paper-textured backgrounds, lit flat like an illustration.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: A paper ground and soft ink lines make tidy puzzles feel homely rather than clinical.

identity.audio_mood: Light piano and plucks; small clicks and rustles for every object.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Order is a pleasure: a puzzle can be 'make it neat' with several right answers. A pet that undoes your work is comedy, not failure.
